features: Five adjustable blueprints: lean-to, windbreak, drying rack, material store and brush hut
Corner/end sizing or hut radius, rotation, saved terrain footings and real component ghost previews
Staged material consumption and timed labour, saved interrupted work, hand restoration and material recovery
Real shelter collision and weather protection, low-roof crouching and usable hut entrance
Nearby craft-accessible physical stock; weather-dependent drying/smoking with source identity and calories retained
Dynamic fire and layered bedding retained, contextual fuel/food/stone additions
Longer scattered/cut wood enables larger plans without stretching pieces or changing branch density/locations
limits: First-pass procedural structure art; no new construction character animations
Blueprint component staging replaces the normal free-form frame placement entry; existing saved frames remain supported
General food spoilage, NPC camp generation and wildfire spread are outside this update
Offscreen camp progression uses the existing current-weather catch-up approximation
Core and native counts are scoped checks, not universal visual quality or total-world performance proof
Earlier native-first flatness failure, native-second obstructed test entrance and native-camp legacy aim failure are excluded; final fresh evidence folders are authoritative
Existing cricket native decode failure and old standalone Earth stage-hash golden discrepancy remain unresolved and are not claimed passing
